monsters.name: Green Slime

names.th: สไลม์เขียว

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 1
monsters.description: Officially designated Beginner Monster No.1 by the Hero Guild. Its green bodily fluid permanently stains clothes, so heroes often file laundry expense claims after hunts.

monsters.name: Dirty Slime

names.th: สไลม์สกปรก

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 3
monsters.description: A variant of Green Slime, mutated by exposure to corruption energy deep in the forest. Its fluid became darker and smellier; gas masks are recommended.

monsters.name: Goblin Warrior

names.th: นักรบกอบลิน

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 6
monsters.description: A small monster that forms tribes on the forest outskirts. Due to their short stature, they have to look up at heroes to fight, reportedly causing frequent neck pain.

monsters.name: Goblin Archer

names.th: นักธนูกอบลิน

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 8
monsters.description: A goblin that specifically picked up a bow. They boast of being 'sharpshooters' but their actual accuracy is low.

monsters.name: Werewolf

names.th: มนุษย์หมาป่า

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 10
monsters.description: A forest wolf mutated by the disturbance of the forest goddess's sanctuary. Despite legends of appearing only on full moons, it actually shows up whenever the weather is nice.

monsters.name: Ent

names.th: เอนต์

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 14
monsters.description: An old tree that gained life. Legend says it was a guardian created by the forest goddess to protect the forest, but it began recognizing passing heroes as enemies after the sanctuary was disturbed.

monsters.name: Sandman

names.th: แซนด์แมน

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 20
monsters.description: A being created when desert sand met corruption energy and gained life. There are rumors that it doesn't hurt even when hit, since its body is made of sand.

monsters.name: Mudman

names.th: มัดแมน

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 22
monsters.description: A Sandman variant, formed from oasis mud that mutated. Rumored to be a major revenue source for the hero guild's laundry service, since clothes get covered in mud after hunts.

monsters.name: Mummy

names.th: มัมมี่

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 25
monsters.description: An undead awakened from ancient ruins. Rumored to be soldiers of an ancient desert kingdom, but actually recently created by the release of the apostle's seal.

monsters.name: Old Mummy

names.th: มัมมี่เก่าแก่

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 27
monsters.description: A much older specimen than regular mummies, with blackened bandages. Legend says it was a general or noble of an ancient kingdom, but it's not much different from a regular mummy.

monsters.name: Black Lizardman

names.ja: ブラックリザードマン
names.th: ลิซาร์ดแมนดำ

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 29
monsters.description: A reptilian humanoid monster dwelling deep in the desert. Its black scales reflect sunlight, making it visible from afar. Heroes call it 'the black dot of the desert'.

monsters.name: Anubis

names.th: อนูบิส

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 31
monsters.description: A jackal-headed monster appearing near the desert goddess's sanctuary. Presumed to be a corrupted deity once worshipped in an ancient desert kingdom, still standing with a dignified posture.

monsters.name: Green Anglerfish

names.th: ปลาตกเบ็ดเขียว

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 36
monsters.description: An anglerfish-type monster from the deep sea. It uses the luminous organ on its head to lure heroes before attacking, but most heroes know it's a trap.

monsters.name: Sea Anglerfish

names.th: ปลาตกเบ็ดทะเลลึก

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 38
monsters.description: A higher variant of the Anglerfish, emerging from even deeper waters. Its teeth are twice the size of the Anglerfish's and much sharper.

monsters.name: Red Starfish

names.th: ดาวทะเลแดง

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 40
monsters.description: A red starfish-shaped monster dwelling on the ocean floor. There are rumors that it's tasty, but no one has actually tried eating it yet.

monsters.name: Pink Starfish

names.th: ดาวทะเลชมพู

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 41
monsters.description: A variant of Red Star with a pink hue, well-received by collectors.

monsters.name: Blue Jellyfish

names.th: แมงกะพรุนน้ำเงิน

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 43
monsters.description: A giant jellyfish that floated up from the deep sea. It's venomous so bare hands shouldn't touch it, but heroes use swords so it's not a problem.

monsters.name: Mermaid Wizard

names.th: นักเวทย์นางเงือก

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 45
monsters.description: An ocean species mutated by the disturbance of the deep-sea goddess's sanctuary. Originally likely a peaceful mermaid, it now attacks passing heroes, consumed by corruption energy.

monsters.name: Lava Squishy

names.th: สไลม์ลาวา

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 50
monsters.description: A being created when volcanic lava combined with corruption energy and gained life. The sight of a hot lava blob wriggling toward heroes instills fear in first-time viewers.

monsters.name: Ash Squishy

names.th: สไลม์เถ้าถ่าน

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 51
monsters.description: A Lava Slime variant formed from clumped volcanic ash. Cooler than the Lava Slime but harder, earning the nickname 'tough rock'.

monsters.name: Flame Spirit

names.th: วิญญาณเปลวไฟ

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 53
monsters.description: A fire elemental materialized from the volcanic goddess's sanctuary. Originally part of nature, it became aggressive after the sanctuary disturbance. Its dancing flames are said to be beautiful.

monsters.name: Evil Flame Spirit

names.th: วิญญาณเปลวไฟชั่วร้าย

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 54
monsters.description: A fire spirit exposed to strong corruption energy. Its flame color changed from red to purple, with much higher aggression. Known as the 'angry flame', but it's presumed to have no actual emotions — just stronger energy.

monsters.name: Elite Lizardman

names.th: ลิซาร์ดแมนชั้นยอด

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 55
monsters.description: A higher-tier reptilian humanoid monster dwelling deep in the volcano. A different species from the desert's Black Lizardman, with red scales and greater vitality.

monsters.name: Ifrit

names.th: อิฟริต

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 56
monsters.description: The supreme fire elemental born deep within the volcanic goddess's sanctuary.

monsters.name: Combat Mech

names.th: Combat Mech

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: The most basic melee combat bot mass-produced by the Mechatronics dimension. It swings the steel pincers attached to both arms in a boxing stance — output is low, but unit cost is cheap, so swarms of them are deployed on the outskirts of Nosgard.

monsters.name: Cannon Mech

names.th: Cannon Mech

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: The long-range bombardment model from the same mass-production line as the Combat Mech. An oversized cannon, far too large for its rounded body, sits atop its head, causing a design flaw where the body staggers from each firing recoil. Heroes target that one-beat opening to take it down.

monsters.name: Repair Bot

names.th: Repair Bot

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: A support-type android designed to instantly repair the Combat/Cannon Mech line on the battlefield. It has almost no direct combat capability, but it has been forced to take to attacking out of self-defense.

monsters.name: Improved Repair Bot

names.ja: 改良型フィックスボット
names.th: Improved Repair Bot

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: A model where ranged attack capabilities were hastily added to the Repair Bot. Its offensive performance is higher than the existing Repair Bot.

monsters.name: Gatling Droid

names.th: Gatling Droid

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: The G-type standard infantry line from Mechatronics. It mounts a massive multi-launcher weapon with both hands, and its solo firepower is top-class among mass-produced bots. The gray paint is the standard identification color for the G-type.

monsters.name: Pyro Droid

names.th: Pyro Droid

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: The F-type standard infantry, designed for paired deployment with the G-type. Its firepower distribution is tuned differently, so when stationed alongside a G-type, blind spots almost disappear. The purple paint is the F-type's identification mark.

monsters.name: Orange Slime

names.th: สไลม์สีส้ม

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: A Green Slime whose fluids turned orange from the aftereffects of the Apostle seal weakening. Exposed to corruption energy a second time, its viscosity has intensified — if it gets on your clothes, disposal is the only option.

monsters.name: Goblin Fighter

names.th: นักสู้กอบลิน

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: The most belligerent among regular Goblin warriors, this variant became obsessed with fighting after being soaked in corruption energy.

monsters.name: Cursed Werewolf

names.th: มนุษย์หมาป่าคำสาป

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: A Werewolf doubly cursed as disruption of Goddess Prestina’s forest sanctuary worsened. It stays berserk regardless of day or night, and its fur has turned black.

monsters.name: Cursed Ent

names.th: เอนต์คำสาป

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: An Ent whose sap became steeped in corruption energy as the forest goddess’s sanctuary grew more polluted. Its wood has hardened further, making it resilient even against fire attacks.

monsters.name: Elite Sandman

names.th: แซนด์แมนชั้นเอก

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: A Sandman variant heavily influenced by Anut’s sanctuary due to the Apostle seal weakening. Corruption energy seeped between sand grains, making its skin sharp as glass shards.

monsters.name: Sturdy Mummy

names.th: มัมมี่แข็งแกร่ง

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: An ancient desert kingdom soldier mummy whose body fully petrified from additional seal weakening. Even its bandages have become hard as stone.

monsters.name: Cursed Desert Lizardman

names.ja: 呪われた砂漠リザードマン
names.th: ลิซาร์ดแมนทะเลทรายคำสาป
names.vi: Người Thằn Lằn Sa Mạc Bị Nguyền

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: A Desert Lizardman that lived near a goddess sanctuary crack and became cursed after prolonged exposure to corruption energy.

monsters.name: Cursed Anubis

names.th: อนูบิสคำสาป

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: An Anubis that completely lost its former dignity as disruption of desert goddess Anut’s sanctuary intensified. Only destructive instinct remains.

monsters.name: Red Angler

names.th: ปลาอังเคอร์แดง

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: A deep-sea Angler that directly swallowed corruption energy from an underwater sanctuary crack. Its lure turned blood-red with much stronger attraction.

monsters.name: Cursed Redstar

names.ja: 呪われたレッドスター
names.th: เรดสตาร์คำสาป

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: A Redstar variant where all five arms were independently cursed due to the Apostle seal weakening. Arms regenerate shortly after being severed.

monsters.name: Corrupted Jellyfish

names.th: แมงกะพรุนปนเปื้อน

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: A Jellyfish that absorbed abundant corruption energy from currents near sea goddess Arbre’s sanctuary.

monsters.name: Mermaid Witch

names.th: แม่มดเงือก

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: A Mermaid mage fully consumed by corruption, now attacking even fellow mermaids. Dark energy mixed into her water magic makes attacks unpredictable.

monsters.name: Cursed Lava Sludge

names.ja: 呪われた溶岩スライム
names.th: ขี้ตมลาวาคำสาป

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: A Lava Sludge that absorbed Apostle-tainted magma from deep within the volcano. Its heat is abnormally intense, slowly melting surrounding rocks.

monsters.name: Cursed Fire Spirit

names.th: วิญญาณเพลิงคำสาป

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: A Fire Spirit whose color turned purple as Goddess Bella’s sanctuary disruption deepened. Each attack burns the surrounding air, draining oxygen.

monsters.name: Cursed Elite Lizardman

names.ja: 呪われた精鋭リザードマン
names.th: ลิซาร์ดแมนชั้นเอกคำสาป
names.vi: Người Thằn Lằn Tinh Nhuệ Bị Nguyền

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: An Elite Lizardman whose scales absorbed the Apostle’s black flames. In addition to fire resistance, it can even reflect dark-attribute attacks.

monsters.name: Cursed Ifrit

names.th: อิฟริตคำสาป

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: An Ifrit infused with the Apostle’s power — a walking catastrophe that sets the air on fire within 3 meters.

monsters.name: Cursed Combat Mech

names.ja: 呪われたファイターボット
names.th: Combat Mech คำสาป

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: A Combat Mech whose circuits have been infused with dark energy after the weakening of the Apostle seal reached even the Mechatronics dimension. Its plating is tinted blood-red, and its pincer swings have become twice as fast — the recoil-beat opening can no longer be exploited.

monsters.name: Cursed Repair Bot

names.ja: 呪われたフィックスボット
names.zh: 被诅咒的修复机动战士
names.th: Repair Bot คำสาป

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: A variant of the Repair Bot line whose exterior was compressed and reshaped into a sphere after exposure to dark energy. The hastily-added attack functions have been reinforced to the level of a proper model.

monsters.name: Cursed Gatling Droid

names.ja: 呪われたメカソルジャーG
names.th: Gatling Droid คำสาป

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: A G-type that has absorbed the Apostle's darkness. The autonomous firing circuit of its multi-launcher has gone haywire, neutralizing friend-or-foe identification. Reports describe even bots from the same line shooting each other.

monsters.name: Cursed Pyro Droid

names.ja: 呪われたメカソルジャーF
names.th: Pyro Droid คำสาป

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: A model in which the F-type, like the G-type, has been consumed by darkness from the same weakened seal. Its paired synchronization has slipped, but in exchange it pours out solo firepower beyond its rated limit, reaching a suicidal output that melts its own armor as it fires.

monsters.name: Soul-Stolen Slime

names.ja: 魂を奪われたスライム
names.th: สไลม์ที่ถูกพรากวิญญาณ

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: After the green slime's soul was dragged to the Fortress of Souls, only the slime body remained, filled with Soltar's darkness. Its fluids glow like a bluish wisp of will-o'-the-wisp, and wherever it is sliced apart, a sound like a moan leaks out.

monsters.name: Soul-Stolen Goblin

names.ja: 魂を奪われたゴブリン
names.th: กอบลินที่ถูกพรากวิญญาณ

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: A goblin whose empty body moves only by Soltar's will. Its aggression and tribal instincts are gone, and it approaches heroes with hollow steps, devoid of rage.

monsters.name: Soul-Stolen Werewolf

names.th: คนหมาป่าที่ถูกพรากวิญญาณ

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: A werewolf whose very beastly instincts were stolen by the Fortress of Souls. The frenzied roar is gone, leaving only a deep moan, and a black mist seeps from between its fangs, blurring the vision of approaching heroes.

monsters.name: Soul-Stolen Ent

names.th: เอนต์ที่ถูกพรากวิญญาณ

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: An ent whose soul was uprooted and dragged away, leaving its hollow trunk to fill with darkness. Faint afterimages of the small forest spirits caught alongside it flicker between its branches, and when it is cut, black ash flows down instead of sap.

monsters.name: Soul-Stolen Sandman

names.ja: 魂を奪われたサンドマン
names.th: แซนด์แมนที่ถูกพรากวิญญาณ

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: A sandman in whom every grain of sand carries a remnant thought from the Fortress of Souls. Each time it scatters and gathers again, its posture changes.

monsters.name: Soul-Stolen Mummy

names.th: มัมมี่ที่ถูกพรากวิญญาณ

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: A doubly tragic mummy, first dragged back from death, then stripped even of its soul. The inside of its bandages feels eerily light as if hollow, yet each time it swings its blade, the laments of the ancient desert soldiers taken alongside it ring out.

monsters.name: Soul-Stolen Lizardman

names.ja: 魂を奪われたリザードマン
names.th: คนกิ้งก่าที่ถูกพรากวิญญาณ
names.vi: Người Thằn Lằn Bị Đoạt Hồn

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: A desert lizardman whose soul was shattered and scattered across the fortress, severing all instinctual control. There is no light in its pupils, and its tail attacks have grown sluggish, yet until it falls, it shows neither pain nor fear.

monsters.name: Soul-Stolen Anubis

names.ja: 魂を奪われたアヌビス
names.th: อนูบิสที่ถูกพรากวิญญาณ

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: An Anubis whose very last remnant of ancient divinity was absorbed by Soltar. Where its dignity and destructive instincts once stood, now only blue will-o'-the-wisps flicker, and the hollow idol moves only by the orders of the Fortress of Souls.

monsters.name: Soul-Stolen Anglerfish

names.ja: 魂を奪われたチョウチンアンコウ
names.th: ปลาอังเคอร์ที่ถูกพรากวิญญาณ
names.vi: Cá Vây Chân Bị Đoạt Hồn

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: An anglerfish whose head lure is directly linked to Soltar's chains of souls. Its light is no longer a bait but a transmission of the last screams of those who were taken, and heroes who draw near are said to glimpse the scenery of the Fortress of Souls in a brief hallucination.

monsters.name: Soul-Stolen Redstar

names.ja: 魂を奪われたレッドスター
names.th: เรดสตาร์ที่ถูกพรากวิญญาณ

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: A redstar whose five-armed souls were each dragged in different directions, throwing its rhythm out of sync. When one arm is cut, another freezes in place, while yet another moves on the wrong beat, collapsing its original defensive pattern entirely.

monsters.name: Soul-Stolen Jellyfish

names.th: แมงกะพรุนที่ถูกพรากวิญญาณ

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: A jellyfish whose soul has dissolved into the fortress's darkness. Its once-transparent body has turned into a dark blue mist, and those whom its tentacles touch fall not into paralysis but into hallucinations of the Fortress of Souls.

monsters.name: Soul-Stolen Mermaid Wizard

names.ja: 魂を奪われた人魚魔法使い
names.th: นักเวทเงือกที่ถูกพรากวิญญาณ
names.vi: Pháp Sư Tiên Cá Bị Đoạt Hồn

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: A mermaid twice transformed: first by corrupting energy, then by Soltar's theft of her soul. Her song is no melody but more akin to a chorus of captured souls, and it is reported that listening too long shakes even a hero's own soul.

monsters.name: Soul-Stolen Squishy

names.th: สควิชชีที่ถูกพรากวิญญาณ

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: A squishy whose lava heat has been replaced with Soltar's dark flame. Its once-red surface has cooled into a dark blue, and from every bubble welling up in its body leaks the lingering thoughts of captured fire spirits.

monsters.name: Soul-Stolen Flame Spirit

names.ja: 魂を奪われた炎の精霊
names.th: วิญญาณเปลวไฟที่ถูกพรากวิญญาณ
names.vi: Tinh Linh Lửa Bị Đoạt Hồn

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: A black flame, all that remains in form, after its very soul — once an elemental being itself — was wholly absorbed into the Fortress of Souls. The heat is gone, and a chill seeps into wherever it touches.

monsters.name: Soul-Stolen Elite Lizardman

names.ja: 魂を奪われた精鋭リザードマン
names.es: Hombre lagarto de élite sin alma
names.th: คนกิ้งก่าชั้นเอกที่ถูกพรากวิญญาณ
names.vi: Người Thằn Lằn Tinh Nhuệ Bị Đoạt Hồn

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: An elite lizardman, once boasting fire resistance, whose soul has been bound, robbing it of all instinctive sense. Its red scales now show a black tinge from within, and its weapon swings drift a beat off, as though someone were controlling it remotely.

monsters.name: Soul-Stolen Ifrit

names.ja: 魂を奪われたイフリート
names.th: อิฟริตที่ถูกพรากวิญญาณ

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: An Ifrit who proves that even the pinnacle of flame spirits was but a single soul before Soltar. The flames it once wore have been swapped for dark flames that even devour the surrounding light, turning a walking furnace into a walking dark hearth.

monsters.name: Soul-Bound Combat Mech

names.ja: 魂縛されたファイターボット
names.th: Combat Mech ที่ถูกล่ามวิญญาณ

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: A unit whose Combat Mech power core has been wholly replaced by Soltar's darkness. A dark blue glow leaks through the gaps in its gray plating, and every time it swings its pincers, the lingering thoughts of other captured machines flicker like signal noise. There is no soul in its circuits, but Soltar has taken its place.

monsters.name: Soul-Bound Repair Bot

names.ja: 魂縛されたフィックスボット
names.th: Repair Bot ที่ถูกล่ามวิญญาณ

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: A Repair Bot whose repair circuits have been rewired by Soltar's will. It no longer mends fellow machines — instead, it binds broken parts with the chains of the Fortress of Souls and forces them upright. The machines it raises obey no one's orders, only the signals of the Fortress.

monsters.name: Soul-Bound Gatling Droid

names.ja: 魂縛されたメカソルジャーG
names.th: Gatling Droid ที่ถูกล่ามวิญญาณ

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: A unit whose standard G-type infantry control signals have been entirely swapped out for Soltar's command system. Identification circuits have been neutralized — friend and foe distinctions are gone, and only a dark blue glow leaks from the gaps in its plating.

monsters.name: Soul-Bound Pyro Droid

names.ja: 魂縛されたメカソルジャーF
names.th: Pyro Droid ที่ถูกล่ามวิญญาณ

monsters.subtitle: Monster · Lv. 60
monsters.description: A unit whose F-type control signals have also been seized by Soltar. The pair-pattern with the G-type is gone, but when both units appear together, they now synchronize like Soltar's two hands and target the same enemy simultaneously.

monsters.name: Emperor Slime

names.th: สไลม์จักรพรรดิ

monsters.subtitle: Boss · Normal Lv. 1
monsters.description: A giant slime that calls itself the king of slimes. It is said to have reached this size by absorbing hundreds of smaller slimes.

monsters.name: Emperor Slime

names.th: สไลม์จักรพรรดิ

monsters.subtitle: Boss · Normal Lv. 2
monsters.description: A giant slime that calls itself the king of slimes. It is said to have reached this size by absorbing hundreds of smaller slimes.

monsters.name: Emperor Slime

names.th: สไลม์จักรพรรดิ

monsters.subtitle: Boss · Normal Lv. 3
monsters.description: A giant slime that calls itself the king of slimes. It is said to have reached this size by absorbing hundreds of smaller slimes.

monsters.name: Elite Goblin W.

names.th: นักรบกอบลินชั้นยอด

monsters.subtitle: Boss · Normal Lv. 4
monsters.description: The largest and strongest among the goblin tribe. It receives chieftain treatment simply for being 10cm taller than the other goblins.

monsters.name: Elite Goblin W.

names.th: นักรบกอบลินชั้นยอด

monsters.subtitle: Boss · Normal Lv. 5
monsters.description: The largest and strongest among the goblin tribe. It receives chieftain treatment simply for being 10cm taller than the other goblins.

monsters.name: Ogre

names.th: โอเกร

monsters.subtitle: Boss · Normal Lv. 6
monsters.description: A massive beast living deep in the forest. Legend says it is an ancient forest guardian corrupted by the disturbance of the forest sanctuary.

monsters.name: Ogre

names.th: โอเกร

monsters.subtitle: Boss · Normal Lv. 7

monsters.name: DioNemesis DX

names.th: DioNemesis DX

monsters.subtitle: Boss · Hard Lv. 25
monsters.description: Even after Apostle Nemesis was sealed away, the Apostle's lingering essence, like an echo, reshaped the broken shell again and again. The charge of a steel colossus with no one to command it and no one to stop it seems proof of the Apostle's nature — that will dwells even in an empty shell.

monsters.name: Soltar, the Twilight Wraith

names.ja: 黄昏の亡霊ソルタール
names.th: Soltar ภูตสนธยา

monsters.subtitle: Boss · Fortress of Souls Phase 1
monsters.description: The lord of Valencia who, in his craving for the power to protect his nation, sank himself into darkness. When the Fortress of Souls awoke, Soltar revealed himself once more, driving a steel chariot drawn by the souls he had captured. The teal glow coiling around the chariot is the souls of the people he offered in sacrifice.

monsters.name: Soltar, the Wraith Beast

names.ja: 亡霊の魔獣ソルタール
names.th: Soltar อสูรภูต

monsters.subtitle: Boss · Fortress of Souls Phase 2
monsters.description: Even with his chariot shattered, he does not stop. Astride the darkness that roams the fortress, driving it like a beast, Soltar is surrounded by a resentment all the deeper for the steel he has lost. His excuse, that it was all a sacrifice for Valencia, now remains as nothing but seething rage.

monsters.name: Soltar, the Lord of Souls

names.es: Soltar, el Señor de las Almas
names.th: Soltar เจ้าแห่งวิญญาณ
names.fil: Soltar, ang Panginoon ng mga Kaluluwa

monsters.subtitle: Boss · Fortress of Souls Phase 3
monsters.description: At last all shells are stripped away, and the Lord of Souls stands bare. With teal spirits trailing like strands of hair, his figure is the tragic, unmasked face of a lord who once sought to protect his people. He who long ago fell to Danan, the Crystal Sword of Light, now stands once more before that same light.

monsters.name: Prototype Fercrow

monsters.subtitle: Special Boss

monsters.name: Masterpiece, Chococrow

names.th: ผลงานชิ้นเอก, ช็อกกา

monsters.subtitle: Special Boss
monsters.description: The second collaboration. Chocolat demanded a counterattack feature, so Fergus built it in. Getting hit by arms loaded with high-density dough hurts quite a bit. Masterpiece is the name Fergus blurted out in admiration right after completion.
